title: Food trail (B): today vs a slower fade
question: Same colony, same endless food pile, frame 21,000. Which food trail looks right?
context_md: Scent strip under the box: pink A, cyan B, square-root scale. Left B fades 0.03 and spreads 0.25 per pass (today). Right fades 0.005 and spreads 0.05 (PIXEL_PHYSICS_B_RHO / _B_DIFFUSE). Earlier tests found a faster fade fed colonies more, so the slow one may cost food on a patchy box.
